Precious Anchor Coins are bringing mysterious grand prizes from the ocean depths to your city.
1. Spend Anchor Coins to draw rewards during the event. Every draw grants points; hit designated point thresholds to unlock matching stage rewards.
2. Complete daily pattern collection quests to claim quest rewards while the event lasts. Any unclaimed rewards will be delivered to your mailbox the following day.
3. Drawing the Pirate Hat Chest pattern unlocks chest opening attempts. One Pirate Hat Chest pattern equals one attempt, with a maximum of 3 opens obtainable per draw. Valuable grand prizes await inside these chests.
4. More matching patterns yield better rewards. Opt for 5x Draw to multiply both draw costs and all rewards by five times.
5. Purchase Anchor Coin Packs throughout the event to obtain Lucky Gold Eggs.
6. Once the event concludes, all Anchor Coins will be converted into speed-up items and mailed to you. Any leftover coins can also be manually recycled from your bag for the same speed-up items.
7. Conversion Ratio: 1 Anchor Coin = 30x Universal Speed-Up (1m)
